# function: render

Renders a dashboard DSL document into the dashboard JSON of the target schema it resolves to, and returns it as a string. The function writes nothing: the caller puts the string where the UI loads it, such as the `content` of an `aws_s3_object` in a bucket the UI's file provider reads. The target schema is the options' `target_schema`, else the one the document's `target_schemas` leave; the provider's `default_target_schemas` apply only to the `dashboard_render` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aws_s3_object" "mock_service_dashboard" {
  bucket       = "mock-config-bucket"
  key          = "grafana/dashboards/mock-owner/mock-service.json"
  content_type = "application/json"
  content      = provider::dashboard::render(file("${path.module}/../../dashboards/mock-service.yml"))
}

output "mock_slots_dashboard" {
  value = provider::dashboard::render(
    file("${path.module}/../../dashboards/mock-game.yml"),
    { target_schema = "grafana", inputs = { game = "mock-slots" } },
  )
}

output "mock_service_dashboard_for_grafana" {
  value = provider::dashboard::render(
    file("${path.module}/../../dashboards/mock-service.yml"),
    { target_schema = "grafana" },
  )
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
render(spec string, options dynamic...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `spec` (String) The dashboard document's text.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Dynamic) At most one object of options: `target_schema`, the target schema to render for, a whole identifier such as `grafana-v2-13` or the leading words of one such as `grafana`; and `inputs`, the values the document's `inputs` are passed, by input name.
